description:
Relevant Experience (Years)                                     
 10+ years experience in working on (develop/design) CRM and/or Enterprise Class Solutions 

 5+ year’s experience with Salesforce.com 

 Technical/Functional Skills                          

 Certified Salesforce.com Developer 

 Experience on Service Cloud is preferred 

 Contact Center experience is preferred 

 Experience in Insurance and/or Financial Services Projects will be good to have 

 Functional and technical knowledge of Salesforce.com and the force.com platform 

 Experience working on Salesforce support projects (handle user communication, understand issues/defects / change requirements, perform impact analysis, create tickets as approp., perform development for changes, lead onsite-offshore team, status and metrics reporting) 

 Custom development experience in Force.com(Apex, visualforce), integration with other enterprise applications and salesforce.com ecosystem applications 

 Experience in designing/developing Web Services/Rest API to interface with other systems 

 Experience with Enterprise Integration and ETL tools 

 Experience deploying web based and enterprise systems using industry standard environments including XML, SQL, HTTP/HTTPS,FTP, Java, JavaScript, jQuery 
 Experience Required                                     

 10+ years experience in working on (develop/design/architect) CRM and/or Enterprise Class Solutions 

 Roles & Responsibilities              

 Provide support on Salesforce platform (day-to-day) defects, enhancement and changes to the application 

 Understand customer's business requirements and technical environment to develop an optimal solution 

 Design solutions on the Salesforce.com Platform leveraging design patterns (standards & solution specific) 

 Collaborate with the different product vendors/app groups while designing the interfaces with 3rd party services, backend systems and various monitoring/analytical tools 

 Lead the development team in delivering the solution 

 Perform quality assurance on deliverables and work products 

 Audit, uncover and resolve data integrity issues 

 Recommend best practices 

 Generic Managerial/Soft Skills 

 1. Energetic, enthusiastic and professional attitude 

 2. Strong communication and interpersonal skills 

 3. Good analytical, problem solving and troubleshooting & Client negotiation skills. 

 4. Looking for a self-driven, passionate individual 

 5. Self-starter and go getter 

 Education            
 Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in technology field or equivalent work experience 


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 12+ Months
